entries.5173c5ba870e9b54: Retailers of construction materials and tools
entries.6a6f0754b84e5abb: This business manufactures and sells drilling and cutting equipment such as core drills, wall cutters and wire saws, and diamond cutting consumables such as diamond core bits and diamond blades. It also handles custom-made machines such as automatic feeders and hydraulic units, and manufactures and sells products through subsidiaries in Taiwan and China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,641 million.
entries.6e677d8ae25f7d3c: The company, headquartered in Shoko Center, Nishi Ward, Hiroshima City, is a group consisting of 9 subsidiaries and 1 affiliated company. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 324, and the company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Its business consists of four reportable segments: the Construction and Living Goods Business, the Cutting Tools Business, the Special Construction Business and the Factory Equipment-Related Business.
